---
title: "Conference dinner"
---

The conference dinner will be held at [Marina Mooloolaba](https://marinamooloolaba.au/) located at 33/45 Parkyn Parade, Mooloolaba from 6pm to 10pm on Thursday evening.

The dinner venue is a short, scenic walk (25min, 1.5km) from the Mantra Mooloolaba Beach. Alternatively, bus transfers from the Mantra Mooloolaba Beach have been arranged to/from the conference dinner venue, with three departures times from the Mantra Mooloolaba Beach: 5:00pm, 5:25pm and 5:50pm, and three return departure times from Marina Mooloolaba: 9:00pm, 9:30pm and 10:00pm. Spaces on the buses are limited, with reservations able to be made at the time of registering or during Thursday (for those waiting on weather conditions).

The dress code for the conference dinner is **smart casual**. The conference dinner venue is a premium waterfront dining and events destination. If in doubt, dress up!
